mapper.select: SELECT t.id, t.credential_id, t.symbol, t.exchange_trade_id, t.exchange_order_id, t.side, o.position_side, t.quantity, t.price, t.commission, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.commission_asset,''), NULLIF(j.commission_asset,'')) AS commission_asset, t.realized_pnl, t.trade_time, o.leverage_snapshot, o.price_tick_size_snapshot, o.post_fill_wallet_balance, o.post_fill_balance_at FROM quant_trade t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id=t.credential_id AND o.symbol=t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id=t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_fill_journal j ON j.credential_id=t.credential_id AND j.symbol=t.symbol AND j.exchange_trade_id=t.exchange_trade_id WHERE t.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND t.symbol=#{symbol} ORDER BY t.trade_time, t.exchange_trade_id, t.id

SELECT t.id, t.credential_id, t.symbol, t.exchange_trade_id, t.exchange_order_id, t.side, o.position_side, t.quantity, t.price, t.commission, COALESCE(NULLIF(t.commission_asset,''), NULLIF(j.commission_asset,'')) AS commission_asset, t.realized_pnl, t.trade_time, o.leverage_snapshot, o.price_tick_size_snapshot, o.post_fill_wallet_balance, o.post_fill_balance_at FROM quant_trade t LEFT JOIN quant_order o ON o.credential_id=t.credential_id AND o.symbol=t.symbol AND o.exchange_order_id=t.exchange_order_id LEFT JOIN quant_strategy_fill_journal j ON j.credential_id=t.credential_id AND j.symbol=t.symbol AND j.exchange_trade_id=t.exchange_trade_id LEFT JOIN quant_trade_cycle_allocation a ON a.credential_id=t.credential_id AND a.symbol=t.symbol AND a.exchange_trade_id=t.exchange_trade_id WHERE t.credential_id=#{credentialId} AND t.symbol=#{symbol} AND a.id IS NULL ORDER BY t.trade_time, t.exchange_trade_id, t.id

SELECT signed_quantity, active_cycle_id, last_trade_time, last_exchange_trade_id, status, incomplete, status_reason, projected_through FROM quant_position_cycle_state WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND position_side=#{positionSide} FOR UPDATE
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_position_cycle_state SET signed_quantity=#{quantity}, active_cycle_id=#{activeCycleId}, last_trade_time=#{lastTradeTime}, last_exchange_trade_id=#{lastTradeId}, projected_through=#{projectedThrough}, status=#{status}, incomplete=#{incomplete}, status_reason=#{reason}, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE credential_id=#{credentialId} AND symbol=#{symbol} AND position_side=#{positionSide}

UPDATE quant_position_cycle SET opening_quantity=opening_quantity+#{quantity}, opening_notional=CASE WHEN baseline_unknown=1 THEN NULL ELSE COALESCE(opening_notional,0)+#{notional} END, remaining_quantity=remaining_quantity+#{quantity}, opening_fill_count=opening_fill_count+1, leverage_snapshot=COALESCE(leverage_snapshot,#{leverage}), price_tick_size_snapshot=COALESCE(price_tick_size_snapshot,#{tickSize}), opening_balance=CASE WHEN baseline_unknown=0 AND opening_fill_count=0 THEN #{balance} ELSE opening_balance END, opening_balance_at=CASE WHEN baseline_unknown=0 AND opening_fill_count=0 THEN #{balanceAt} ELSE opening_balance_at END, updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('OPEN','OPENING_UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT baseline_unknown FROM quant_position_cycle WHERE id=#{id}
mapper.update: UPDATE quant_position_cycle SET closing_quantity=closing_quantity+#{quantity}, closing_notional=closing_notional+#{notional}, remaining_quantity=#{remainingQuantity}, realized_pnl=realized_pnl+#{realizedPnl}, closing_fill_count=closing_fill_count+1, status=#{status}, closed_at=#{closedAt}, closing_balance=COALESCE(#{balance},closing_balance), closing_balance_at=COALESCE(#{balanceAt},closing_balance_at), updated_at=NOW(6) WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('OPEN','OPENING_UNKNOWN')
mapper.select: SELECT id, credential_id AS credentialId, symbol, cycle_key AS positionCycleKey, position_side AS positionSide, direction, opening_quantity AS openingQuantity, closing_quantity AS closingQuantity, remaining_quantity AS remainingQuantity, opening_notional AS openingNotional, closing_notional AS closingNotional, realized_pnl AS realizedPnl, opening_fill_count AS openingFillCount, closing_fill_count AS closingFillCount, leverage_snapshot AS leverage, price_tick_size_snapshot AS priceTickSizeSnapshot, opening_balance AS openingBalance, opening_balance_at AS openingBalanceAt, closing_balance AS closingBalance, closing_balance_at AS closingBalanceAt, opened_at AS openedAt, closed_at AS closedAt, status, baseline_unknown AS baselineUnknown FROM quant_position_cycle WHERE credential_id IN <foreach collection="credentialIds" item="credentialId" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{credentialId} </foreach> <if test="symbol != null and symbol != ''">AND symbol=#{symbol}</if> <if test="fromUtc != null">AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at>=#{fromUtc}</if> <if test="toUtc != null">AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at<#{toUtc}</if> ORDER BY COALESCE(opened_at,created_at) DESC,id DESC LIMIT #{limit} OFFSET #{offset}

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM quant_position_cycle WHERE credential_id IN <foreach collection="credentialIds" item="credentialId" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{credentialId} </foreach> <if test="symbol != null and symbol != ''">AND symbol=#{symbol}</if> <if test="fromUtc != null">AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at>=#{fromUtc}</if> <if test="toUtc != null">AND opened_at IS NOT NULL AND opened_at<#{toUtc}</if>

SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT CONCAT(credential_id,':',symbol)) FROM quant_position_cycle_state WHERE credential_id IN <foreach collection="credentialIds" item="credentialId" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{credentialId} </foreach> AND (status<>'READY' OR incomplete=1) <if test="symbol != null and symbol != ''">AND symbol=#{symbol}</if>

SELECT position_cycle_id AS cycleId, allocation_role AS allocationRole, exchange_order_id AS exchangeOrderId, exchange_trade_id AS exchangeTradeId FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation WHERE position_cycle_id IN <foreach collection="cycleIds" item="cycleId" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{cycleId} </foreach> ORDER BY position_cycle_id,trade_time,exchange_trade_id

SELECT position_cycle_id AS cycleId, COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(commission_asset)),''),'UNKNOWN') AS commissionAsset, SUM(commission) AS commission FROM quant_trade_cycle_allocation WHERE position_cycle_id IN <foreach collection="cycleIds" item="cycleId" open="(" separator="," close=")"> #{cycleId} </foreach> GROUP BY position_cycle_id,COALESCE(NULLIF(UPPER(TRIM(commission_asset)),''),'UNKNOWN') ORDER BY position_cycle_id,commissionAsset
